title: Volvo FM FUPS Low Line FUPS Bullbar #21
description: Volvo FM-FH FUPS Lowline bull bar. This bar is designed to allow for the grill to be opened without dropping the Bullbar assembly. The lower box uprights still give maximum protection to the cab with the ease of access for daily maintenance checks. All tube is 76mm diameter hi-tensile aluminium. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with heavy duty tow pin. Driving lights can be mounted in the hi-tensile lower extrusion each side of the number plate. One set of roo-slicers.
